definitions.explanation: The act of saying goodbye to someone who is leaving, especially someone who is departing a workplace or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}する→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a farewell party for a colleague who is being transferred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{送別|そうべつ}する⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a send-off ceremony for the graduates.

examples.japanese: {送別|そうべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave flowers as a farewell gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to give a speech at the farewell party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}する→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席：02084_shusseki⟧。
examples.english: Everyone in the department attended the farewell party for the retiring manager.

notes:
{送別|そうべつ} is used when saying goodbye to someone departing, particularly in work or school contexts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧: farewell party
- {送別|そうべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞|じ}→辞：noentry⟧: farewell speech
- {送別|そうべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧/⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: farewell gift

CONTEXTS:
- When a colleague transfers or resigns
- When students graduate
- When someone leaves a group or organization

CONTRAST:
- ⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧: welcome (opposite of farewell)
- ⟦{歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい}→歓送迎会：noentry⟧: party for both welcoming new and farewell to departing members
